items.where: SE quay wall: three fronts in one buff brick family on one wall plane: banded west block, bay front, taller pinkish east block
items.how: per-front colour segments and window systems along the measured wall line

items.where: west block (s 0-19): framed window groups, a dark slatted brick panel beside a two-light window, five per storey between proud brick bands
items.how: shallow dark panel opening beside each window; proud brick ledge strips at the storey lines

items.where: bay front: six proud buff brick bays 4.8 m wide with one window per storey, crowned at about 14 m
items.how: 0.35 m proud brick pilasters and crown head on each bay, windows cut in the wall between

items.where: recesses between the bays with cantilevered balconies behind solid brick parapets, three storeys
items.how: 0.8 m deep recess with a dark back and a solid-parapet balcony per storey

items.where: pale stone columns and beam in front of a glazed shop ground floor under the bay front
items.how: stone slabs for the columns, a stone beam strip, shopfront openings between them

items.where: east block (s 63-80): taller, paler sandy brick, small punched windows, a balcony stack at its west edge, a covered gateway in the ground storey
items.how: paler band colour, measured punched openings, parapet balconies, deep dark gateway opening

items.where: light metal rail/pergola on the roof terraces over the bay front

skip.note: a thin rail set back on the roof terrace, barely visible from the quay
